description: Takes no arguments and returns the business profile: name, timezone, and website, where website is the primary site or null when there is none. website has siteId, brandName, domain, previewHost, tagline, phone, address { street, city, state, zip }, businessHours, serviceArea, googleBusinessProfileUrl, and status. Use it for who the business is, its contact phone, address, hours, and site; use neuron_services for the service list and prices. This Neuron Expert MCP server tool is read-only and reads only the one business whose owner approved the connection and granted read:business on the consent screen. Results are JSON objects also returned as text; the limit is 60 requests per minute per connection, and a refused read returns a tool error with a short reason text.
name: neuron_business
title: Get business profile
